meta.title: Partial / Multiple GRNs against a Single PO: refused for a user without the Warehouse Executive role
gaps: Sign in as a user without the Warehouse Executive role and attempt to raise multiple partial GRNs against one PO.
Repeat the same Partial / Multiple GRNs action as a Warehouse Executive and compare availability or refusal.
Observe or record tenant RBAC configuration when the action is granted to additional roles.
